    Quotient and submodule generation on an indecomposable skeleton #

    This file defines membership in add S, Fac(add S), and Sub(add S) by explicit finite biproduct presentations. The finite indexing type is bundled so that iterated finite sums can be flattened without any cardinality bookkeeping.
